test_title: PYST 33: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the number from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

13, 17, 19, 23, 29, ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

The series are given in **Prime number order**.

13, 17, 19, 23, 29, **31**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4710fda010144b3ef7c2b410856d76aac7030cc4a7bc3fe4a904b68c741ac33a.png] 

Here, '31' is the next prime number will complete the series.

Hence, the correct answer is **"31"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Prime Number table from 1 to 100.
